name.ja: SD ガンダム 三国伝 043 真 黄蓋グフ
name.en: SD Gundam Sangokuden 043 Shin Huang Gai Gouf

ja: • 孫権軍に仕えた歴戦の武将。
• 「虎爪盾」は虎が彫りこまれた盾。鋭い爪が付いていて、攻防一体の武器となる。
• 「鉄砕鞭」は棍棒形態から鞭形態へ変化可能。
成形品×5、シール×1、取説マンガ有り
en: • A veteran military commander who served in Sun Quan's army.
• "Tiger Claw Shield" is a shield carved with a tiger. It has sharp claws and can be used as a weapon for both offense and defense.
• "Iron-Slashing Whip" can change from club form to whip form.
Molded product x 5, Seal x 1, instruction manual manga included
